(WALK-IN-INTERVIEW)
The Walk-in-Interview for filling up one post of 'Electrician' purely on contract basis on
current DC rates of Chandigarh i.e. Rs. 28,432/- PM (fixed) with 06 days working in a
week, initially for period of 89 days with one-day break after completion of term &
further extendable as per needs of the PUSSGRC, Bajwara, Hoshiarpur will be held in the
office of the Director, PUSSGRC, Hoshiarpur on 12/10/2026 at 11: 00AM onwards.
The eligible candidates must report at 10:30 AM on particular day in the office of the
PUSSGRC, Bajwara, Hoshiarpur. (No candidate will be entertained afterwards).The
candidates must bring the attached application & all original certificates related to their
educational qualifications & experience etc. alongwith one self-attested photocopy set of
all certificates for verification as per minimum educational qualifications prescribed for
the above said post at the time of interview.
Qualifications:
"Matric with two (02) years ITI Diploma in Electrician Trade from a recognized
Institute."
Age Limit:
Not less than 18 years & more than 37 years as on the last date prescribed for holding
Walk-In-Interview. The relaxation in age for SC/ST candidates will be given as per the
University rules.
Other Terms & Conditions:
1. The post is purely on contract basis & the selected candidate will be appointed initially
for 89 days which may be further extended solely as per requirements of the PUSSGRC,
Bajwara, Hoshiarpur.
2. Duty hours are adjustable as per the needs of the Centre and as assigned by the
Director, PUSSGRC, Hoshiarpur from time to time.
3. The appointment shall be terminable without any notice & the candidate will have no
claim whatsoever to retrenchment compensation, regularize his contractual service or
continuity in service or re-employment after the expiry of his contractual appointment.
4. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the Walk-In-Interview.
5. All other terms & conditions are applicable as per the University rules.
6. For latest updates, please visit the official website regularly.
Sd/
Director
